issues.description: Return-type annotation and docstring for dd_create_zero_state in the template disagree with the problem statement and the solution. The problem statement and the solution state that dd_create_zero_state should return a DD representing the n-qubit |0...0> state, but the template's function signature and docstring claim it returns a DDNode. This mismatch is structural (type/signature) and can confuse students about the expected return value and what to construct/return.
issues.suggested_fix: Update the template function signature and docstring to match the specification and solution: change the return annotation from DDNode to DD (-> DD) and update the docstring to say it returns a DD corresponding to the n-qubit zero state. Ensure any necessary imports/types are consistent. This preserves the pedagogical intent while removing the type/signature inconsistency that could confuse students.
